snippet.title: The 90s Space Sim Is Back - and how it is... | Wingmen Chronicles First Trailer
snippet.description:
Climb into the cockpit. Fly with your wingman, dogfight raider aces and run the flak of a battleship in Wingmen Chronicles — a new space combat sim in the spirit of the 90s classics.
🚀 Coming soon to Steam and itch.io
They told you how to fly. They told you how to fight. Now launch.

All flight and cockpit footage is captured in-engine.

• Dogfight from a living cockpit: lock on, cannons, guided rockets — and Shock Rockets that short-circuit an enemy fighter in a crawl of lightning.
• Command your wingman over the comm: "Alpha Two, attack my target."
• Take on capital ships: bomber torpedo runs, battleship flak curtains, raider transports.
• Live aboard the carrier TCS Resolute: walk the decks as Nova, take your briefing, launch from the bay, and make it home.
• Pre-rendered ships like the classics, morphing smoothly, all in one 256-colour palette.
• Flight stick supported.

🔔 Subscribe for cockpit gameplay, Shorts and devlogs — and to be there when the Steam page opens.
💬 What was the first space sim you ever flew? Tell us below.

#indiegame #spacesim #gamedev

Made with ai-assisted tools; all gameplay captured in-engine.
